FULL TEXT:
Advertisement
Inviting Applications for the Post of Director, IIBM, Guwahati
Indian Institute of Bank Management, Guwahati (IIBM, the Institute) was established
and registered as a society in 1980. It is an autonomous institute mandated to meet
the capacity building imperatives of banks and financial institutions, especially from
the North-eastern region. The primary mission of the Institute is to offer quality
education in the area of banking and finance and creating a cutting-edge management
capability both at individual and organisation levels in financial institutions.
Role
The Director is the Chief Executive Officer of the Institute, providing knowledge
leadership and functions under the overall guidance of a highly distinguished
Governing Board chaired by the Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India. The
Director shall provide leadership and inspiration to the faculty and staff and exercise
general supervision and control over the affairs of the Institute in compliance with
relevant statutory and regulatory requirements. The Director is required to be stationed
in Guwahati.
Expectations
The key requirements for the position are – an exceptional track record in leadership
and institution building, the drive to further the Institute’s mandate, and the ability to
find innovative solutions by networking with local institutions, government and
development agencies. The Director should be a highly motivated individual who is
committed to taking the Institute to the next level of prominence and making it an
institution of eminence in the North-eastern region.
Qualifications and Experience
Applications are invited from seasoned bankers / distinguished professionals / policy
makers / academic administrators who fulfil the following eligibility criteria:
• Should be an Indian citizen and not be older than 62 years of age as on January
01, 2027. The appointment shall be initially for a term of three years and
extendable up to five years, subject to satisfactory annual review.
• Minimum qualification: Post Graduation.
• Desired qualification: Additional weightage shall be given to MBA / PhD holders.
• Eligibility:
(i) Serving / Retired officials of commercial banks / All-India Financial
Institutions / Financial Sector Regulators not below the rank of Chief General
Manager (CGM) / equivalent rank with minimum 25 years of overall service,
Or
(ii) Professors from reputed educational institutions dealing in banking / finance
/ economics / management studies, and having minimum ten years of
experience in that rank are eligible to apply.
• Experience:
(i) Should have work experience in Banking and Finance Sector with focus on
administration / credit risk management / credit supervision / payment and
settlement / rural credit and development / treasury,
Or
(ii) Should have teaching experience in banking / finance / economics /
management studies along with experience of handling administrative
responsibilities.
• Experience of institution building / nurturing a reputed training institute in the
financial sector would be given additional weightage.
Terms and Conditions
The Director will draw a monthly fixed pay of ₹2,25,000 plus DA (in line with pay level
17 of 7th CPC) and is eligible for perquisites as approved by the Governing Board.
However, in case of serving officials of RBI, if selected for the position, she / he shall
be deemed to be posted at IIBM.
Selection Process
The selection process will be steered by a Selection Committee (SC). SC reserves the
right to call for applications by invitation for outstanding candidates. The final authority
for appointment of Director rests with the Governing Board of IIBM. The selected
candidate is expected to join the Institute latest by third week of December 2026.
Qualified and interested applicants should apply online through the link given on
official website of IIBM, Guwahati (https://iibm.ac.in) on or before October 5, 2026.
Received applications shall be treated with confidentiality. For any clarifications, kindly
write to csbdefissc@rbi.org.in
